response.text:
I have enough evidence to submit. Summary of what I verified:

- Journals balance (no unbalanced GLJRNL journals).
- Invoice 803 is a negative-amount invoice whose journal 2475 posts equal DR and CR amounts; its INV_AMT is negative and the journal tie-out does not match by sign convention. I'll report it as a tie-out anomaly.
- Invoice 509 is paid at 16989.66 against an invoice of 16989.65 (one-cent overpayment).
- Duplicate invoices: 348/802 (V0014, same INV_NO after trimming/padding), 510/801 (V0001, same INV_NO differing by trailing spaces).
- Account 5900 is inactive (ACTV_FLG 'N') but used in journals 1941 and 2271.
- Every GLPERD period referenced is closed, and posting dates fall inside their periods, so I found no closed-period posting with a date mismatch.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (348, 802) ORDER BY 1
findings.summary: Invoice 802 duplicates invoice 348: same vendor V0014 and same invoice number V0014-15732-348 once leading/trailing spaces are trimmed; same amount 12228.60.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (510, 801) ORDER BY 1
findings.summary: Invoice 801 duplicates invoice 510: same vendor V0001 and same invoice number V0001-57211-510 once trimmed; same amount 981.43. Invoice 510 is paid while the duplicate 801 is open.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT j."JRNL_NO", j."ACCT_CD", j."DR_AMT", j."CR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNL" j JOIN "GLCOA" c ON UPPER(TRIM(c."ACCT_CD"))=UPPER(TRIM(j."ACCT_CD")) WHERE c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y' ORDER BY 1
findings.summary: Account 5900 is retired (ACTV_FLG = 'N' in GLCOA) but is posted to in journals 1941 and 2271.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=803
findings.summary: Invoice 803 has a negative INV_AMT (-6853.75) while its recorded journal 2475 carries 6853.75 on both DR and CR, so the journal does not reflect the invoice amount/sign.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID"=509 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD"
findings.summary: Invoice 509 is marked paid but payments total 16989.66 against an invoice amount of 16989.65 (overpayment of 0.01).
